description: This PHP source file defines a class 'Upgrade3' within the Opencart installation upgrade process, responsible for extracting and applying a specific upgrade zip package. It manages file extraction, directory creation, and progress tracking for upgrading OpenCart to version 3.

classes.name: Upgrade3
classes.description: A controller class responsible for upgrading the OpenCart installation to version 3 by extracting files from a zip archive and updating configurations.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method executing the upgrade process: reads request parameters, processes the upgrade zip file, extracts files selectively, and manages the upgrade progress status.
